agreement_clauses:
Scope of Work
GB Studios will design and deliver the visuals listed in the accompanying proposal for the project named above.

Payment
50% of the agreed fee is paid before work begins and the remaining 50% before final delivery. Payments are non-refundable once work starts.

Revisions
The fee includes 3 rounds of free revisions. Additional edits are charged separately. Editable files are available at an additional cost.

Timeline
Work runs for the period stated in the proposal. Delivery dates depend on the Client supplying content and feedback promptly.

Rush Work
Same-day projects attract an additional fee of 10–30%.

Portfolio
GB Studios may display the completed work in its portfolio.
